Alex — hi, Marissa (Solutions) stepping in with the technical details you asked for. Below is a short breakdown; more detail is in the attached audit log spec.

What we collect (high level):
- Admin/console events: user sign-ins, role changes, policy updates, model deployments, API key rotations.
- API request logs: request metadata, requester identity (token id, account id), model invoked, request/response timestamps, token counts, and status codes.
- System events: infra restarts, autoscaling events, and health check records (where applicable for Dedicated/Private deployments).

Export formats & delivery:
- Formats supported: newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON), CSV, and Parquet for analytics ingestion.
- Delivery options: secure S3 bucket with server-side encryption and pre-signed URLs for one-time download; cross-account S3 share for enterprise; or push to your SIEM via HTTPS endpoint (mutual TLS).

Immutability and attestations:
- For hosted exports we can provide an export bundle with a signed manifest (SHA256 checksums) and an export timestamp signed by our key. For Dedicated/Private customers we support WORM-configured object storage.
- Note: while we can't change historical logs, we do keep an internal audit trail that records any export operations, who requested them, and the manifest signature.

Retention: you can choose 12/24/36 months; we support policy-based retention and can configure auto-archival to cold storage (read-only) after X days.

Next steps I recommend: 
1) I’ll attach the Request-Evidence-Matrix (spreadsheet) we typically use to map required questionnaire items to artifacts.
2) If you can drop the vendor questionnaire, I’ll circulate internally and set a 3-business-day SLA for initial answers for common items (SOC2 status, encryption at rest/in-transit, retention controls).

Alex — hi, Maya (Security) chiming in with the controls-level answers you may need for the vendor questionnaire: 

- SOC 2: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II as of Q4 2025. We can provide the summary report and a cover letter from our Auditor. Full SOC 2 reports are provided under NDA.
- Encryption: data at rest uses AES-256; in transit is TLS1.2+ with modern ciphers. Key management integrates with KMS/HSM for Private customers.
- Export attestations: each export bundle includes a signed manifest (SHA256) and a signature using a rotating key (we publish JWKS). For Dedicated customers we can enable WORM at the object level.
- Chain of custody: export requests, who initiated them, and manifest verification records are recorded in our internal audit trail (separate from event logs) and are available in the evidence bundle.

Action item: Please send the vendor security questionnaire (Alex mentioned) and I’ll assign owners internally to complete it. If you prefer a live handoff of artifacts, Marissa and I can do a screenshare to walk through one example export.

Best regards,
Maya Srinivasan
